note: Facturo is a fictional B2B invoicing SaaS (create, send, collect invoices; API and integrations). Lists: Inbox, Triage, In progress, Waiting on customer, Done. Fields: Priority (P1/P2/P3), Category (Billing/API/Integration/Account), Customer (text), Agent status (text). Cards in Inbox are reset before each demo; cards elsewhere age naturally.

tickets.name: Discount for long-time customer?
tickets.desc:
Hi, we've been on the Team plan since June 2025 and I saw a mention of a loyalty discount on your site. Could you confirm what we're entitled to and whether it applies automatically? Also, a colleague told me new customers get 5%, is that still right?

Thanks,
Lena Fischer, Office manager, Nordic Threads

tickets.name: Invoice PDFs are broken since we uploaded our new logo
tickets.desc:
Every invoice we generated this morning has a broken layout: the logo overlaps the invoice number, the totals column is cut off on the right, and the line items are misaligned. Screenshot attached. We send about 60 invoices a day to clients and had to stop. We use the custom template we set up last year.

Marco Bellini, Finance lead, Casa Verde Studio

tickets.name: invoice.paid webhooks stopped after we moved to a new server
tickets.desc:
We migrated our backend last week and since then we don't receive invoice.paid webhooks, so our CRM never marks deals as paid. The dashboard shows deliveries as failed. Our endpoint answers 200 as far as we can tell.

Anika Sørensen, Developer, Bolt & Bloom

tickets.name: Wrong VAT lines on split invoices to a Swiss client
tickets.desc:
When we split one project into two invoices for a client in Zurich (one for goods, one for consulting services), the second invoice applies French VAT instead of reverse charge, and the first one shows two VAT lines. The client's accountant rejected both. We create invoices through the API with the same customer object. Happy to share payloads.

Julien Maret, CFO, Alpine Consulting

tickets.name: Payment link on our invoices says expired
tickets.desc:
Since yesterday, clients who click Pay now on our invoices land on a page saying the payment link has expired. Nothing changed on our side that I know of.

Sofia Ricci, Owner, Ricci Ceramics

tickets.name: Recurring invoices go out at 2am instead of 9am
tickets.desc:
Our monthly retainer invoices are scheduled for 9:00 but clients receive them around 2:00 in the morning, which looks unprofessional. We're in Lisbon.

Tom Reyes, Founder, Pedal Marketing

tickets.name: Quote for annual prepay on Team plan
tickets.desc:
We're happy with the trial and want to commit for a year. What discount can you offer for paying the year upfront? We'd also like to know if the loyalty discount would stack on top later.

Priya Nair, COO, Saffron Box

tickets.name: Getting 429 on /invoices during our end-of-month batch
tickets.desc:
On the last day of the month our job creates around 1,500 invoices from our ERP and gets rate-limited halfway. What's the limit and is there a batch endpoint?

Daniel Okafor, Backend engineer, Urban Sprout

tickets.name: Pay now link expired (same as my colleague's message?)
tickets.desc:
Clients tell us the payment link is expired. Sorry if this is a duplicate, Sofia may have sent one already.

Luca Ricci, Ricci Ceramics

tickets.name: Feature request: separate invoice numbering per client
tickets.desc:
We'd like a numbering series per client (ACME-2026-001, ...) instead of one global sequence. Some of our clients require it for their own audits.

Lena Fischer, Nordic Threads

tickets.name: API key rotated, ERP integration still using revoked key
tickets.desc:
We rotated our API key and now our ERP connector returns ERR_AUTH_401.

Hannah Weiss, Green Ledger
comments: Reply to customer: Hi Hannah, the connector still holds the old key. Update it under Integrations > ERP > API key and save; the 401 stops immediately. Let us know if you need help. Facturo pre-sales team

tickets.name: Wants one invoice per department
tickets.desc:
Can we issue separate invoices per department to the same client? Three departments, one client.

Omar Haddad, Finance, Souk Digital
comments: Reply to customer: Hi Omar, yes: create the client three times with a department suffix, or use the cost-centre field on line items and filter at export. Which do you prefer? Facturo pre-sales team

tickets.name: Blocked: waiting on Stripe about a failed payout
tickets.desc:
Payout of 12 September failed on the Stripe side. Case opened with Stripe support.

Elena Petrova, Vela Home
comments: Note: Stripe case #S-4471 opened, 5 business days SLA on their side.

tickets.name: Upgrade from Solo to Team mid-month
tickets.desc:
How is the upgrade prorated?

Maya Lindqvist, Fjord Knits
comments: Reply to customer: Hi Maya, the upgrade is prorated to the day; you pay the difference for the remaining days of the month. Facturo pre-sales team

tickets.name: How to correct an invoice that was already paid
tickets.desc:
We invoiced the wrong amount and the client already paid.

Daniel Okafor, Urban Sprout
comments: Reply to customer: Hi Daniel, a paid invoice cannot be edited. Issue a credit note for the difference from the invoice page (More > Credit note), then a new invoice if needed. Facturo pre-sales team
Note: resolved with a credit note.
